description: A performance stopwatch that counts elapsed clock time, alongside a divider giving a quarter, half or whole note pulse

params.text: Sets the displayed time back to zero, leaving the pulse output alone
Starts the timer, or pauses it and holds the time on the display; pressing it again carries on from the held time
Chooses the pulse interval: 1/4 gives a pulse on every clock, 1/2 on every second one and 1 on every fourth. It comes up on 1

inputs.text: One pulse per quarter note. The timer counts the time between these pulses, and the pulse output is divided down from them
A rising edge restarts the pulse count from the first of the four beats, leaving the elapsed time alone
A rising edge starts the timer, or restarts it from the held time if it was paused

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 10ms long at the chosen interval

notes: the timer does not advance on its own. Patch a clock to CLCK and press RUN; the display then counts the time the clock takes
a gap longer than two and a half times the previous clock interval is left out of the elapsed time, so a stopped clock does not add its dead time

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
